contract_completeness: Every required field has an explicit JSON type, shape, defining equation or predicate, and canonicalization rule.

alpha_wedge_star_scalar.definition: positive-volume coefficient of alpha wedge star(alpha)

star_alpha.canonicalization: keys increasing i,j,k; exactly nonzero terms
star_alpha.json_type: object from index triples to rationals

star_star_alpha.canonicalization: keys increasing; equals star_square_sign times alpha
star_star_alpha.json_type: object from index triples to rationals

representation_conventions: Indices are zero-based unless a mathematical exponent or degree is explicitly named. Matrices are row-major; nested tensor array order is stated per task.

A rational scalar is a reduced JSON string "n" or "n/d" with positive denominator. JSON integers are used only where the field contract says integer. Floats, decimal approximations, NaN and infinity are invalid.
The submission object has exactly required_fields, with no additional keys. Nested objects likewise use exactly the named keys.
task_rules: A form map key i,j,k means coefficient of e^i wedge e^j wedge e^k, with 0<=i<j<k<6. Orientation e^0 wedge ... wedge e^5 is positive.
For diagonal metric g, let rho=sqrt(product_i g_i). For ordered I and increasing complement J, star(e^I)=sign(I concatenated J)*rho/(product_(i in I)g_i)*e^J.

Maps contain exactly the nonzero coefficients in increasing key order. alpha_wedge_star_scalar is the coefficient of the positive volume form in alpha wedge star(alpha). The second star satisfies star(star(alpha))=(-1)^(degree*(dimension-degree))*alpha.
